units.source_text: 此外吟咏甚多，不可胜数。

en.t: Besides these, there were so many poems composed that they could not be counted.
But none of them was worth much attention, so there is no need to recount them all.

units.source_text: 大凡此等时节所咏诗歌，即使是长于此道的男子，亦不能有佳作。

en.t: In general, poems composed on occasions like this cannot turn out well, even when written by men skilled in the art.

units.source_text: 除了“千岁松”之类的文句以外，不会另有新颖之词，

en.t: Apart from phrases such as the thousand year pine, there is unlikely to be any fresh wording,
and it amounts to nothing more than stale cliches.
